五件穿戴配华戒才激活六件；食人鱼等法力消耗技能命中后，宠物对目标获得8秒套装增伤.enUS: Five equipped pieces plus Ring of Royal Grandeur activate the six-piece bonus. After a Mana spender such as Piranhas hits, pets gain the set damage bonus against that target for eight seconds.

邪毒狂欢 / 杰拉姆穿戴互换.enUS: Carnevil / Mask of Jeram worn-slot swap

两件头部可按词缀质量互换穿戴与萃取，默认穿邪毒狂欢是因为其特效固定且更容易比较词.enUS: The two helms can swap worn and cubed positions according to affix quality. Carnevil is worn by default because its power is fixed and its affixes are easier to compare.

穿戴杰拉姆的词缀显著更好.enUS: When the worn Mask of Jeram has clearly better affixes

最高冲层的守关者时间成为主要瓶颈.enUS: When Rift Guardian time becomes the main bottleneck at the highest push tier

持续攻击同一首领可叠加伤害.enUS: Repeated attacks against one boss stack damage

清理普通怪群弱于困者.enUS: Weaker than Bane of the Trapped for clearing normal packs

金币、移速与金织带护甲链.enUS: Gold, movement speed, and the Goldwrap Armor chain

大秘境不掉金币，完全失效.enUS: Greater Rifts do not drop gold, so it is completely inactive

实际护甲不足，无法完成收割和站定吹箭.enUS: When actual Armor is too low to complete Soul Harvest and stand to fire

失去智力带来的伤害和全抗.enUS: Lose the damage and All Resistance provided by Intelligence

只创建T16普通小秘境速刷.enUS: Create only a T16 Nephalem Rift farming scenario

精确来源没有给出GR速刷、蓝门、悬赏或幻化农场配置；金织带和囤宝者也依赖掉金币内.enUS: The exact sources do not provide Greater Rift speed, portal, bounty, or cosmetic-farm setups. Goldwrap and Boon of the Hoarder also require gold-dropping content, so no extra purpose is forced.

初入T16先保拉昆巴；确认金币链和伤害稳定后用沃兹克赶路；组队或随从不能发散复仇.enUS: Keep Lakumba's when first entering T16. Use Warzechian for travel after the gold chain and damage are stable; equip Nemesis on the hero only when a group or follower cannot Emanate it.

T16生存稳定且场景物件密集.enUS: When T16 survival is stable and environmental objects are plentiful

破坏物件后提高移速.enUS: Gain movement speed after breaking objects

祭坛召唤更多精英.enUS: Summon more elites from shrines and pylons

巅峰和卡德山提供足够智力、攻速档位与生存都达标后，手套智力才可换范围伤；没有统一.enUS: Replace glove Intelligence with Area Damage only after Paragon and Augments provide enough Intelligence and the Attack Speed and survival targets are met. There is no universal automatic Paragon 2000 cutoff.

面板攻速超过2.00、双暴齐全且实战坚韧足够.enUS: Sheet Attack Speed above 2.00, both Critical affixes complete, and enough real-world toughness

失去智力的伤害与全抗.enUS: Lose Intelligence-based damage and All Resistance

魔女的攻速和冷却支持档位与技能循环；T16让随从发散复仇者与贪婪之戒。Ninte.enUS: The Enchantress's Attack Speed and cooldown support the breakpoint and skill loop. In T16, Nemesis Bracers and Avarice Band Emanate from the follower. Skill mapping and Emanate behavior still require Nintendo Switch testing.

单人GR推进是主用途。.enUS: Solo Greater Rift progression is the primary use.

T16普通小秘境可用，但Icy明确提示相对顶级速刷有小缺点。.enUS: T16 Nephalem Rifts are viable, but Icy explicitly notes minor drawbacks versus top farming builds.

不创建GR速刷、蓝门、悬赏或高低巅峰复制场景。.enUS: Do not create Greater Rift speed, portal, bounty, or duplicated low/high-Paragon scenarios.

当前效果是最近10只鬼娃同步，而不是5只或全部鬼娃。.enUS: The current effect synchronizes the ten nearest Fetishes, not five or all Fetishes.

Icy装备页仍写5只；Blizzard当前物品页和Icy技能页写10只，因此按当.enUS: Icy's gear page still says five, while Blizzard's current item page and Icy's skill page say ten. Use the current official value of ten.

五件祖尼玛配华戒激活六件；法力消耗命中提供8秒宠物增伤标记。.enUS: Five Zunimassa pieces plus Ring of Royal Grandeur activate the six-piece bonus; a Mana-spender hit applies an eight-second pet-damage mark.

角色和鬼娃毒镖穿透并获得额外伤害。.enUS: The hero's and Fetishes' darts pierce and deal additional damage.

当前采用Icy的骷髅王肩、拉昆巴与无尽之途；d3guides采用奥吉德、斯奎特和.enUS: The current setup follows Icy with Pauldrons of the Skeleton King, Lakumba's, and Endless Walk. d3guides uses Aughild's, Squirt's, and Convention of Elements, so the full gear set is not cross-checked.

保留更完整解释词缀、断点和替换条件的Icy方案；第二方案作为差异记录，不混拼。.enUS: Retain Icy's setup because it explains affixes, breakpoints, and replacement conditions more completely. Record the second setup as a difference rather than mixing them.

Icy与d3guides对爆发技能、位移符文和收割符文存在差异。.enUS: Icy and d3guides differ on the burst skill, mobility rune, and Soul Harvest rune.

当前采用Icy详细技能页；d3guides的火焰飞镖、惧灵和不同灵魂行走符文不混.enUS: The current setup follows Icy's detailed skill page. d3guides' Flaming Dart, Horrify, and different Spirit Walk rune are not mixed in.

至简之力和侍从宝石是两颗固定核心宝石。.enUS: Simplicity's Strength and Enforcer are the two fixed core gems.

多数推进采用困者，最高冲层首领瓶颈改受罚者。.enUS: Use Bane of the Trapped for most progression and switch to Bane of the Stricken when the highest-tier Rift Guardian becomes the bottleneck.

Icy正文区分困者与受罚者用途；d3guides直接使用受罚者。.enUS: Icy's text distinguishes the uses of Bane of the Trapped and Bane of the Stricken; d3guides uses Bane of the Stricken directly.

黄转红由实际护甲瓶颈触发，不存在2000巅峰硬切。.enUS: An actual Armor bottleneck triggers the Topaz-to-Ruby swap; there is no hard Paragon 2000 cutoff.

Icy默认黄并按坚韧切红；d3guides直接全红，但未给固定巅峰断点。.enUS: Icy defaults to Topazes and switches to Rubies for toughness. d3guides uses all Rubies but gives no fixed Paragon breakpoint.

第一目标是面板攻速超过2.00，对应29帧档位。.enUS: The first target is sheet Attack Speed above 2.00, corresponding to the 29-frame breakpoint.

第39赛季巫医海德格赠礼是魔牙，祖尼玛不是直接开荒赠礼。.enUS: The Season 39 Witch Doctor Haedrig's Gift is Helltooth; Zunimassa is not a direct starter gift.

Nintendo Switch技能映射、宠物射线控制和随从发散尚未实机验证。.enUS: Nintendo Switch skill mapping, pet firing-line control, and follower Emanate behavior have not been tested in game.

当前精确构筑来源是PC页；Blizzard物品机制页为跨平台，但不等于Switc.enUS: The current exact build references are PC pages. Blizzard's item-mechanics pages are cross-platform, but they do not validate Switch controls.

法力标记 → 最近10只鬼娃同步穿透毒镖.enUS: Mana mark → ten nearest Fetishes fire synchronized piercing darts

邪毒狂欢只让最近10只鬼娃同步角色的剧毒飞镖，箭镖匕刃让这些飞镖穿透；食人鱼必须.enUS: Carnevil synchronizes only the ten nearest Fetishes with the hero's Poison Dart, and The Dagger of Darts makes those darts pierce. Piranhas must keep refreshing Zunimassa's eight-second six-piece pet-damage mark.

攻速帮助跨越毒镖档位，冷却与远程控场支持灵魂行走和安全射线。.enUS: Attack Speed helps cross the dart breakpoint, while cooldown and ranged control support Spirit Walk and a safe firing line.

不是全部鬼娃：只有最近10只同步，但所有同步飞镖都会被箭镖匕刃强化并穿透。.enUS: Not all Fetishes: only the ten nearest synchronize, but every synchronized dart is amplified and made piercing by The Dagger of Darts.

角色与鬼娃飞镖穿透增伤.enUS: Hero and Fetish darts pierce and deal more damage

只吹箭不能启动六件；每组高价值目标都要先被法力消耗技能命中。.enUS: Firing darts alone does not activate the six-piece bonus. Every valuable target group must first be hit by a Mana spender.

标记目标8秒.enUS: Mark the target for eight seconds

先让面板攻速超过2.00，再比较范围伤、双暴或更高攻速档；不要只看到高巅峰就自动.enUS: First raise sheet Attack Speed above 2.00, then compare Area Damage, Critical stats, or a higher breakpoint. Do not replace affixes automatically just because Paragon is high.

固定发动机上补攻速.enUS: Add Attack Speed on the fixed engine item

配合两枚戒指跨档.enUS: Combine with both rings to cross the breakpoint

鬼娃数量也是防线.enUS: Fetish count is also a defense

祖尼玛四件按每只鬼娃提供减伤；进图未召军团或鬼娃死亡时，伤害与坚韧会一起下降。.enUS: Zunimassa's four-piece bonus grants damage reduction per Fetish. Damage and toughness both fall when Fetish Army has not been summoned or Fetishes die.

先召满鬼娃并用食人鱼刷新8秒标记，再沿怪群长轴吹箭；关键怪群开启震地狂舞。.enUS: First summon enough Fetishes and refresh the eight-second mark with Piranhas, then fire along the pack's long axis. Activate Slam Dance for key packs.

仅按T16普通小秘境配置：恐怖追猎、撞魂、灵魂耗竭与金币链负责转场，不外推为GR.enUS: Use this only as the T16 Nephalem Rift setup: Stalker, Severance, Soul to Waste, and the gold chain provide travel. Do not extrapolate it to Greater Rift speed farming or bounties.

不按低巅峰复制装备；核心件、六件标记、拉昆巴层数和2.00攻速入口优先。.enUS: Do not duplicate gear for low Paragon. Prioritize core items, the six-piece mark, Lakumba's stacks, and the 2.00 Attack Speed entry point.

不按2000巅峰自动换宝石；生存与档位都满足后，才把手套智力等词缀让给范围伤。.enUS: Do not change gems automatically at Paragon 2000. Replace affixes such as glove Intelligence with Area Damage only after survival and the breakpoint are satisfied.
